root_cause: The canonical production snapshot workflow packaged exact source on main push but did not execute the authorized Netlify deploy because its deploy/proof steps were restricted to workflow_dispatch only. This left production on an older commit after a valid pricing merge.
prevention_rule: When the production snapshot workflow itself is changed on protected main, its push-triggered run must execute the same authorized Netlify transport and exact production proof as an explicit deploy dispatch, while retaining bounded readback and fail-closed identity checks.

tests: Production Source Snapshot run 35717260615 completed successfully but logs showed only source packaging; deploy/proof steps were skipped by the workflow_dispatch-only condition.
evidence.outcome: Candidate restores push-triggered authorized deployment and exact-SHA proof for the snapshot workflow.
evidence.production_readback: Pending protected merge and exact Netlify production identity.
